name: serotinous cone mechanism

phase_0.boundary_condition: Mature cone structure containing the resin-sealed scale mechanism

VINIT.justification: Pre-zygotic state before cone differentiation and resin synthesis

TANCH.justification: Closed boundary containing the resin-sealed scale mechanism and seed bank

AFWD.justification: Directed transformation toward scale opening and resin phase change

AREV.justification: Reverse morphism maintaining sealed state and resin viscosity

CLINK.justification: Chaining thermal response from external fire to internal resin and scales

IMSCRIB.justification: Self-recognition of the cone's fire-adapted design across generations

FSPLIT.justification: Splits cone state into [Melting/Opening, Sealed/Dormant] paths based on heat

FFUSE.justification: Fuses opened and sealed paths back into [Cone Structural State] post-cycle

EVALT.justification: Affirmative branch: scales separate and seeds release

EVALF.justification: Negative branch: scales remain sealed and seeds retain dormancy

ENGAGR.justification: Paradice: cone holds both structural integrity and opening readiness without resolution

IFIX.justification: Append-only ecological shift post-fire, locking succession trajectory

phase_3.void_description: Unformed seed mass before cone differentiation and resin synthesis
phase_3.true_description: Heat threshold met, scales open, resin fluid, seeds released
phase_3.false_description: Heat threshold unmet, scales sealed, resin solid, seeds dormant
phase_3.both_description: Simultaneous thermal stress and structural integrity, tension and release held

steps.domain_action: Genesis of unformed seed mass in void
Establishment of mature serotinous cone boundary
Approach of thermal energy toward cone surface
Sequential heat transfer to resin-sealed scales
Heat exceeds resin melting point on T-arm
Resin phase transition to fluid state
Thermal expansion propagates to scale joints
Heat remains below critical threshold on F-arm
Resin maintains solid viscosity on F-arm
Structural tension remains dormant on F-arm
Reintegration of thermal outcome into cone state
Simultaneous tension and release potential held
Soil nutrient descent into root zone
Closed boundary of mature forest state

phase_5.memory_mechanism: Dormant seed bank and resin state logs
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Seasonal fire cycle and temperature thresholds

phase_6.cycle_cost: Thermal energy and resin phase change latent heat
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Sealed cone with solid resin and dormant seeds
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Open cone with dispersed seeds and altered soil chemistry
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — Thermal energy input equals latent heat of resin phase change and seed dispersal work; system remains thermodynamically balanced across the cycle
